Stave Falls offers exceptional waterfront lifestyle on Stave Lake with recreation paradise and the natural beauty that outdoor enthusiasts cherish. This tight-knit Mission community attracts families and retirees seeking lakefront properties from seasonal cottages to year-round residences, many featuring private docks, water access, and stunning lake and mountain views. Residents love year-round recreation including swimming, fishing, boating during summer, plus hiking and nature activities throughout the area's provincial parks and trails. The community maintains strong connections through local events, active neighborhood spirit, and genuine care among neighbors. Despite the recreational lakeside setting, Mission's shopping, schools, and services are reasonable drives via improved roads, and Highway 7 provides access for regional commuting.

Properties offer outstanding waterfront value compared to other Lower Mainland lakes, with authentic cottage-country character and established community atmosphere. Stave Falls' natural setting and recreation focus make it perfect for active lifestyles. Ready to explore lakefront living?
